corrections.prior_claim: The four-element integer centralizer is identified as the image of MCG(K).
corrections.correction: Arbitrary lift matrices may differ by the deck action. The canonical orientation-preserving lift has image {I,-I}, with a nontrivial kernel; it is not a faithful four-element matrix representation.

corrections.prior_claim: Trace two is carried by the trivial mapping class and not a Dehn twist.
corrections.correction: The matrix must be I, but the half-translation is a nontrivial Dehn-twist class with this matrix and trace two. The matrix theorem itself remains correct.

corrections.prior_claim: The weaker trace-two reading has no nontrivial carrier.
corrections.correction: The weaker trace condition has a nontrivial carrier. It does not establish self-linking or physical parameter identifications.
